display.purpose: Folio H1 and landing title. The largest mark on any surface; announces the entry.

headline.purpose: Grand Index and Category Index page titles. One step below the folio title.

title.purpose: Index row title — the name column. 600 is the heaviest Cormorant weight loaded; do not synthesize bolder.

body.purpose: Prose content and field values. Prose column caps at 640px for reading measure.

label.purpose: Section headers, field labels, button text, eyebrows. Tracked uppercase Spectral — the single structural voice.

mono.purpose: Schema warnings and the edit view's code blocks only. Raw ui-monospace stack.

shadows.name: overlay-soft
shadows.purpose: Search dropdown. Diffuse parchment-toned lift for a transient overlay.

shadows.name: overlay-medium
shadows.purpose: CxSelect menu and tag-filter dropdown. Slightly deeper for a heavier panel.

shadows.name: overlay-accent
shadows.purpose: Inline wikilink picker popover. Rust-tinted to signal the focused state.

motion.name: color-fast
motion.purpose: Sidebar folio links, clear buttons. Quick color transitions for list interactions.

motion.name: color-standard
motion.purpose: Type rows, tags, CTAs, sync button. Default color/background transition.

motion.name: border-input
motion.purpose: Edit-mode inputs and picker wraps. Snappy focus transition on form controls.

breakpoints.name: pending
breakpoints.purpose: Zero @media queries ship today. The 88px folio title, fixed 240px sidebar, and fixed 280px meta column break under ~1100px. A breakpoint strategy is a known design-backlog gap, not a decision.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save / Confirm. The only filled control on a surface; its filled state is the hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--text-primary, #221b13); color: var(--bg-page, #f3ead8); border: 1px solid var(--text-primary, #221b13); font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 24px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary.danger { background: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); border-color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Cancel / Copy / secondary actions. Outline, muted; hover deepens text and border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdb98e); font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); border-color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); }

components.name: Add Button
components.description: Category Index 'Add'. Outline in the rust accent — the create voice.
components.css: .ds-btn-add { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-add:hover { background: rgba(138, 53, 34, 0.08); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Edit-mode text field. Warm-translucent ground, hairline border, rust focus.
components.css: .ds-input-text { font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); background: rgba(255, 250, 235, 0.55); border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdb98e); padding: 7px 10px; outline: none; width: 100%; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 120ms, background 120ms; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); font-style: italic; } .ds-input-text:focus { border-color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); background: rgba(255, 250, 235, 0.9); }

components.name: Wikilink Chip
components.description: Signature. Inline, rust text, gold type glyph. Dead links drop to muted with a help cursor — no strikethrough.
components.html: Locations/Crete
components.css: .ds-chip-wikilink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-size: 16px; color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-wikilink:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); } .ds-chip-wikilink.dead { color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); cursor: help; } .ds-chip-icon { color: var(--accent-gold, #9a7a2c); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Edit-mode tag. Gold-tinted ground and border, square, with a muted remove button.
components.css: .ds-chip-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); background: rgba(154, 122, 44, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(154, 122, 44, 0.4); padding: 3px 4px 3px 8px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-chip-remove { background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; padding: 0 4px; } .ds-chip-remove:hover { color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); }

components.name: Backlink Card
components.description: The only resting 'card' in the system. Vellum ground, soft border, 4px radius, no shadow. Hover deepens border and ground.
components.html:
Death of Hector
Slain by Achilles outside the walls of Troy…
components.css: .ds-card-backlink { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px; background: var(--bg-panel, #ebe0c8); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, #d9c8a4); border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-card-backlink:hover { border-color: var(--border, #cdb98e); background: var(--bg-hover, #e4d8be); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-snippet { font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-style: italic; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Folio Link
components.description: Sidebar entry link. Transparent, muted, 2px left rule. Active turns rust with a tinted ground.
components.css: .ds-nav-folio { display: block; padding: 2px 32px; font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-size: 18px; color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); border-left: 2px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-folio:hover { color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); } .ds-nav-folio.active { color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); border-left-color: var(--accent-rust, #8a3522); background: rgba(138, 53, 34, 0.07); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Index Entry Row
components.description: Signature (ADR-0011). One nowrap line: Cormorant 600 name column (content-relative clamp) + Spectral gloss. Truncates with ellipsis; never wraps.
components.html: AchillesGreatest warrior of the Greeks; slain by Paris near the Scaean Gate.
components.css: .ds-entry-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(108, 94, 70, 0.35); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-entry-row:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-entry-title { flex: 0 0 clamp(9ch, 22%, 24ch); min-width: 0; font-family: var(--ff-display, serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary, #221b13); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-entry-gloss { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-family: var(--ff-body, serif); font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-muted, #6c5e46); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

narrative.overview:
Axiom Forge is the worldbuilder's illuminated manuscript — a schema-driven encyclopedia rendered in the language of hand-set type, gold leaf, and iron-gall ink on parchment. The metaphor is not costume; it is the structural logic of the interface. Content is the illumination; the chrome is the vellum and rule that holds it.

The feel is archival and precise. This is a reference work that takes itself seriously — an encyclopedia, not a notebook — and the typography and palette carry that authority. Cormorant Garamond sets the folio titles at a scale that demands the page be read, not scanned; Spectral carries the prose and the labels with the evenness of a well-printed book. The palette is a narrow band of warm parchment tones bracketed by a single antique gold (the illuminator's leaf) and a single deep rust (the iron-gall stamp of an active or warning state). Nothing else is in color, because nothing else needs to be.

The system is flat by default. Depth is conveyed by tonal layering — parchment page, vellum panel, hairline and dotted rules — and by the typography itself, which does most of the hierarchical work that shadows would do in a lesser system. Shadows appear only on transient overlays (dropdowns, dialogs, popovers), where they mark a surface lifted momentarily off the page. Components are restrained and refined: buttons are quiet, often outline or ghost, and the primary action earns its weight by being the only filled control on the surface; inputs are transparent with a hairline or dashed rule that darkens to rust on focus. The content is the loud part.
keyCharacteristics: Print-aesthetic, archival, precise — a reference work, not a SaaS product
Two-serif typography: Cormorant Garamond for display, Spectral for body and labels
Narrow parchment palette + two accents (antique gold, deep rust); no other color
Flat by default; tonal layering and rules carry depth, shadows only on overlays
Restrained controls; the primary action is the only filled button on a surface
Hairline and dotted rules as the primary structural device
Tracked, uppercase Spectral eyebrows as the section/label vocabulary
Every text run in lists and cards truncates with an ellipsis; nothing wraps

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: The palette has exactly two accents: Antique Gold for identity, Deep Rust for state. No third accent, no semantic color invented for 'success' or 'info.' Route every colored state through one of the two — gold for soft integrity warnings, rust for hard errors and active state.

rules.name: The Tonal-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth between static surfaces is conveyed only by stepping between Parchment, Vellum, and Border. Never by a shadow. A card is darker than the page; a panel is darker than a card; that is the whole depth vocabulary at rest.

rules.name: The Two-Serif Rule
rules.body: Display is Cormorant Garamond; body and labels are Spectral. Never set body in Cormorant or titles in Spectral — the hierarchy depends on the family contrast.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Voice Rule
rules.body: Section headers, field labels, and button text are Spectral 500, 11px, uppercase, tracked 0.18em–0.22em. This is the single structural voice of the system; do not introduce a second label style.

rules.name: The Italic-Is-Secondary Rule
rules.body: Italic marks secondary, 'also known as,' or placeholder voice — the folio subtitle, alias bylines, tag runs, search/filter placeholders, empty-state copy. It is not a decorative switch.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow on any surface at rest — not cards, not panels, not buttons, not inputs. Shadows are the exclusive vocabulary of transient overlays (dropdowns, popovers, dialogs). A shadow on a resting card is a SaaS-dashboard tell and is wrong here.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Where a lesser system would drop a shadow to separate two surfaces, this system draws a 1px hairline (--border or --border-soft) or a dotted rule. The dotted field rule is the signature separator within a meta section.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Default radius is 0. Radius appears only on small controls (2px) and on cards/dropdowns (4px), and never as a design feature — only where a slightly softened corner aids a dense cluster. Never introduce a pill, a lozenge, or a radius above 4px.

rules.name: The Border-State Rule
rules.body: Border style encodes state: solid = read/structural, dashed = editable/focused, dotted = separator within a list. Do not mix these — a dashed border on a resting card is meaningless, a dotted border on an input is wrong.

dos: Do set every color, spacing, radius, and font size from a tokens.css token. npm run lint fails on undefined var(--…) references; prefer an existing token and add to tokens.css only when the system genuinely lacks the concept.
Do convey depth between static surfaces by stepping between Parchment, Vellum, and Border — tonal layering, not shadows.
Do use the tracked uppercase Spectral eyebrow (--fs-eyebrow, 0.18em–0.22em) for every section header, field label, and button. It is the single structural voice.
Do reserve Deep Rust for state and consequence (active, focus, warning, delete) and Antique Gold for identity (type chips, icons, wikilink glyphs). The two accents have jobs; do not swap them.
Do use the dotted rule (rgba(108, 94, 70, 0.35)) to separate fields within a meta section — it is the signature list separator.
Do truncate every text run in lists and cards with an ellipsis. Uneven heights break vertical rhythm more than a clipped tail breaks one entry.
Do size the index name column content-relative (clamp(9ch, 22%, 24ch)) so rows align by construction across projects and zoom levels.
Do flow the Grand Index column-major (CSS multi-column, break-inside: avoid per letter group). An alphabetical index is scanned down a column, then to the next.
donts: Don't use SaaS-dashboard vocabulary: no rounded lozenges, no bright accent fills on resting cards, no drop shadows on cards or panels at rest, no 'card grid' feel. Axiom Forge is a print-aesthetic reference work, not Notion or Confluence.
Don't put a box-shadow on any resting surface. Shadows are the exclusive vocabulary of transient overlays (dropdowns, popovers, dialogs).
Don't introduce a third accent color, a 'success green,' or an 'info blue.' Route every colored state through Antique Gold (soft integrity) or Deep Rust (hard state/error).
Don't use a radius above 4px, a pill, or a lozenge. The default corner is 0; 2px and 4px are the only softening, and only on small controls and cards.
Don't use native <select>, native checkbox/radio chrome, or any browser control that breaks the parchment typography. Use CxSelect and custom controls.
Don't set body text in Cormorant Garamond or titles in Spectral. The hierarchy depends on the family contrast.
Don't synthesize a Cormorant Garamond weight heavier than 600. 700 triggers a faux-bold smear; the index row title uses 600 for this reason.

Don't add Tailwind, CSS-in-JS, or inline styles that hardcode colors, spacing, or typography. Inline styles for dynamic computed values (positions, transforms, dimensions) are fine; everything else goes through tokens and CSS Modules.
Don't show the literal [[ ]] brackets around wikilinks in the UI, and don't strikethrough dead links. Dead links are identified by a muted color, cursor: help, and a tooltip.
